Admit absence of any previous customization and exact ownership/mode before writing. Activate only for the exact registered sys.orig_argv, admitted parent process, and owned interpreter. All other invocations are no-op. No workspace/user-site injection, global interpreter chmod, product wheel edit or import path override.

child_observer.mechanism: Standard sys.setprofile on the admitted child main thread plus threading.setprofile for its original subsequently created request thread. Observe code frames; do not replace original product or transport callables.
child_observer.thread_boundary: Claude uses its original hol-guard-claude-hook-request thread for authenticated transport. Main-thread-only capture would be incomplete. Track bounded per-thread stacks/intervals; do not assume ContextVar propagation or add threads.
selected_frames: Admitted product module execution and actual importlib find/load calls after observer activation, with explicit nested import accounting.
Exact existing Claude/Codex bridge main/dispatch, authenticated-state reads, challenge request and verification, original hook HTTP request/response reader and result projection.

child_observer.source_admission: Pre-bind full selected product wheel/source roster and the finite function code filename/name/definition map. Bind the actual interpreter/frozen importlib implementation. No per-frame file hashing or new native identity probe.

child_observer.profile_semantics: A profile return event may be exception unwinding; do not label it a successful function return. Actual original process/contract results determine outcome.
child_observer.loss_behavior: Any bound, unknown selected-frame identity, failed activation/restoration/export, missing child or outstanding stack makes attribution incomplete. Disable further capture on bound without interrupting original product work. Never enlarge caps after seeing an outcome.

observer_costs.capture_self_time: Record callback count and aggregate callback entry/exit elapsed time, setup interval, export interval and imported-module roster before/after observer setup. Those measurements are diagnostic work, not a basis for subtracting a hypothetical clean latency.
observer_costs.preloaded_dependencies: Explicitly retain modules loaded by observer setup; they may move imports earlier and alter caches/order. Do not credit their later absence as eliminated product work.
unmeasured: interpreter work before the startup observer activates
OS scheduling/cache changes caused by observation
observer_costs.interval_rules: Same process/thread interval unions and direct-child remainders only. Cross-thread overlaps cannot be summed as elapsed critical-path cost. No cross-process clock subtraction or native Rust-internal attribution.
